title: Samsung Note10 Plus problems
body:
Samsung Note 10 Plus stops receiving data from G6 after a few readings. After restarting the collector, it works again for a few readings.
On the G6 status, the phone service stats is "Scanning xx:xx", and the Bluetooth Link stays in connecting.

comments.body:
Hi, I have Note 10 Plus too. I had that exact same issue with it at first.
Currently have 100% capture by changing this setting:
Glose GATT on BLE disconnect - ON

I also opened the Dexcom app to clear a battery warning as G6 transmitter is now ~90 days old. I believe that may sometimes cause a loss of data, not sure as transmitters last a while, but towards transmitter end of life it I find it necessary to clear the battery warning in the Dexcom app before Xdrip can work flawlessly.
